translations.web: Until the day is cool, and the shadows flee away, I will go to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.
translations.bsb: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
translations.kjv: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
translations.asv: Until the day be cool, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, And to the hill of frankincense.
